messages:
nina: FYI we finished the A/B for the adaptive-request-coalescer + locality-aware-routing stack. Win across the board for latency tail and per-token spend. Moving to broad rollout in 30m. :rocket:

nina: Quick summary (prod-synth mix):
```text
Control: p50=28ms, p95=110ms, p99=310ms, cost/token=$0.00145
Variant: p50=27ms, p95=92ms,  p99=245ms, cost/token=$0.00103
Net: p99 -21%, cost/token -29%
Hot-path (seq<=512): p99 -18%
Long-context (>4k): p99 -15%, GPU mem pressure -14%
```

alex: nice. any QoE/decoding diffs? did the coalescer reorder tokens in a way that affects deterministic clients?

nina: no deterministic diffs observed in our regression set. we intentionally keep per-request ordering; coalescer only groups compatible requests (same sampling params + model shard). will add a note in changelog about grouping semantics.

chao: backend note: locality routing reduced cross-host KV hits by ~40% so we saw less inter-node traffic and lower RPC tail. also switched a small kernel path to fused-attention-io which helps the 512-token hotpath.

alex: what's the rollout plan & auto-rollback gates?

nina: rollout: 0->canary(3%) -> 3% -> 15% -> 50% (now) -> 100%. holding at 50% for 45m. Metric gates: error-rate increase >0.4% OR p99 regression >3% => rollback. can rollback via feature-flag flip in infra console.

ops-bot: Deployment event: commit=fa12b4e promoted to 50% on prod, regions: us-west/us-east-eu. Monitoring: perf-gates OK, error-rate OK. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/full/coalescer-vs-control

emily: can you draft a 2-sentence blurb for comms? would like an exec-friendly line for Monday ops update.

nina: sure. DM-ing you the blurb. idea: "Runtime: rolled out adaptive request coalescer + locality routing; p99 latency improved ~21% and per-token costs ~29% on common workloads."

chao: small follow-ups: schedule a bench-run for the multi-tenant heavy tail (10k concurrent) and update the capacity estimator. the sweet spot for coalescer threshold is 12-18ms grouping window; we'll tune per pool.

alex: please add a short note in the runbook about the grouping window and ordering guarantees. also add a flag for customers that need strict no-coalesce mode.

nina: will add to runbook and PR: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/coalescer-rollout. copying @support for special-cases.

emily: :clap: great work team. let's keep an eye on the 45m hold and reconvene after 100% or rollback.

(automated) metrics collected: p50/p95/p99, cost/token, kv-cross-host-rate, gpu-mem, error-rate, coalesce-rate.
